title: Focauld Casterwill/Quotes
summary:
"It's the Foundation's time now. Ours has ended. Let us preserve our history by surviving." Focauld Casterwill to the Casterwills (Sophie on Trial)

"It makes me wonder why you choose to tell her about the test at all. It had been made by our strongest Rue Guardians in ancient times, you know."
- Focauld Casterwill to Lucas Casterwill (Sophie on Trial)

"Today, you gave me something to believe in again."
- Focauld Casterwill to Sophie Casterwill (The Spiral War)
